question: Where and with what formula is the ṭa-class syllable group assigned to Varuṇa?
premises: The ṭa-class-beginning syllable is placed in the throat.
The placement is followed by the formula to Varuṇa.
The formula concludes with obeisance thus.
inference: The ṭa-class syllable group is installed in the throat with the obeisance formula addressed to Varuṇa.
plain_english: Afterwards, place the syllables beginning with the ṭa class in the throat with the formula: obeisance to Varuṇa.
